gloss: to empty; to make room; to vacate

definitions.gloss: to empty; to make room; to clear out
definitions.explanation: To remove the contents of something, making it empty or creating space.
To leave a position, seat, or place unoccupied. Also used for making time available.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{出|だ}しを{空|あ}けてスペースを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I emptied the drawer to make space.

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}の{中身|なかみ}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{空|あ}けてテーブルに{並|なら}べた。
examples.english: I emptied all the contents of the box and lined them up on the table.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}の{午後|ごご}を{空|あ}けておく。
examples.english: I'll keep next week's afternoon open.

examples.japanese: {長期間|ちょうきかん}{家|いえ}を{空|あ}けるときは、{近所|きんじょ}に{声|こえ}をかけておく。
examples.english: When leaving the house vacant for a long time, let the neighbors know.

notes: Written with the kanji {空|あ}ける to distinguish from {開|あ}ける (to open) and {明|あ}ける (to dawn). Sense 1 focuses on removing contents; sense 2 focuses on leaving a place or time slot unoccupied. Transitive verb. Collocations: {席|せき}を{空|あ}ける (vacate a seat), {家|いえ}を{空|あ}ける (be away from home), {時間|じかん}を{空|あ}ける (make time available), {場所|ばしょ}を{空|あ}ける (clear a space).
